d: When a powerful gang plagues Virginia City with a murderous protection racket, the Cartwrights are determined to stop it even as it threatens them.
A young bank robber gets a job on the Ponderosa to prevent the sheriff from finding the other members of his gang.
Charlie Trent used to be an Army scout, but now he's the town drunk. Hoss helps him regain his self-esteem when he has him volunteer to lead a gold-bearing troop through the desert.
A Deputy U.S. Marshal arrives to escort a man to California to testify against a gang  guest Dan Duryea.
The Cartwrights' neighbor Tom Edwards has lived as a paraplegic ever since an accident involving Ben Cartwright and a gun.
An authority on American history finds evidence that Jed's ancestors preceded the Mayflower to America.
Cousin Pearl gets a glamour treatment and tries to groom the Clampetts for high society.
Jed takes a dose of Granny's tonic and ends up on Lovers Lane with a gold-digging secretary.
